title: Video by ankurwarikoo
description:
3 money rules we follow for our parents.

1/ We sponsor their travel. 
Wherever they want to go, and whoever they want to go with, we want them to enjoy travelling.

2/ We give them a fixed monthly amount. 
Since their retirement, the money goes into their account on the first of every month, and they can spend it however they want.

3/ We buy them a new phone every two years. 
We do it without asking because otherwise, they'll keep using the same phone - and we never tell them the actual price!

Taking care of your parents isn't always about giving them money. It's about giving them the freedom to enjoy it.
